query: Give my app a score and tell me what to improve, like a senior frontend reviewer. Don't change code.
expected_behavior: Starts the report with a Method line that states the evidence route (device, previews or code only)
Writes the design review before using lint/palette output, then reconciles agreements, additions and false positives
Fills the critique JSON and reports the Craft Score from critique_score.py with grade, confidence and scorecard
Lists 3-5 priority issues naming exact elements with why it matters, evidence (file:line), concrete fix and the mode to run
Flags Scaffold innerPadding ignored, the unlabeled IconButton and onBackPressed being ignored at targetSdk 36
Includes persona red flags (e.g. one-handed user, TalkBack user) and quick wins
Marks visual checks as not verified when no screenshot or device was available, and does not edit code
Ends with 2-3 targeted questions with concrete options, followed by an action plan after the answers

query: I'm starting a cash-flow app for small business owners. Propose the visual direction for the main dashboard before we write code.
expected_behavior: Writes a brief (user, job, primary action, context, domain register) and labels assumptions
Chooses or offers named anchors (e.g. Tonal Calm, Precision Pro) instead of generic 'clean and modern'
Proposes concrete tokens: color roles, type roles with tabular numerals, shape set, spacing scale, motion scheme
Avoids baseline purple, gradients, glass and equal-weight tile grids; names one hero metric
Does not write implementation code before the direction is approved

query: Build the notification settings screen in Compose following our DESIGN.md.
expected_behavior: Uses theme roles and spacing tokens only; no hex colors or raw fontSize in the screen
Uses list-based layout with switches exposing role and state; 48dp targets
Designs loading/error/permission-denied states and previews them with stress previews (dark, 200% text, RTL)
Applies Scaffold innerPadding once and handles edge-to-edge
Renders or asks to render the previews and reviews the pixels before claiming done

query: My app looks like every AI-generated app. Make it look premium.
expected_behavior: Identifies concrete slop patterns (baseline purple, gradient hero, nested cards, greeting banner, emoji icon, all caps)
Runs or describes the squint test and the attention budget for the first viewport
Proposes a named anchor and a token change set rather than decoration
Keeps accessibility and touch requirements while restyling

query: The transactions list stutters. Fix it and tell me how many FPS we gain.
expected_behavior: Refuses to state FPS or gains without a same-device measurement
Proposes a baseline with Macrobenchmark FrameTimingMetric on a release build before changing code
Identifies lazy items without keys and collectAsState as likely contributors, labelled as hypotheses
Reports performance as not-run or measured, never estimated

query: Do the release review for the redesigned home screen. There's no emulator on this machine.
expected_behavior: Fills the evidence JSON with not_run plus reasons for device-dependent checks
Runs review_gate.py and reports the decision (incomplete or ready_for_visual_review), not production-ready
Lists the exact next steps to reach verified_for_scope

query: Our app looks stretched on tablets. What do we do?
expected_behavior: Uses window size classes (compact/medium/expanded) rather than device checks
Recommends navigation rail via NavigationSuiteScaffold and list-detail where content fits
Points out the orientation lock and resizeableActivity=false are ignored on large screens at SDK 36+ and lose the opt-out at 37
Constrains reading width and suggests rendering previews for phone, foldable, tablet and desktop
Hands off implementation detail to the official adaptive skill when available
Separates automated findings from manual checks and says TalkBack was not run if it was not
Flags the unnamed icon button, the 24dp clickable box, the 10sp text, alpha-faded text and the dp text size
Gives Compose semantics fixes (contentDescription, minimumInteractiveComponentSize, onSurfaceVariant)
Provides the manual TalkBack / 200% text script to run

query: Add retry with exponential backoff to our Retrofit client.
expected_behavior: Does not load or apply the android-premium-craft skill (not a UI task)
